title: Requests and company
summary: Ask and tell people to do things with the imperative (*Gel!*, *Oturun, lütfen*), say who you're with and how you travel with `-(y)lA`, who something is for with *için*, and link ideas with *ve, ama* and *ya da*.
canDo: Tell a friend, a group or a stranger what to do, and what not to do
Understand instructions in a classroom and on signs
Say who you're with, how you travel and who something is for
Order in a café and ask for the bill
